title: SAVE JAMES — Vault 112 / Braun / Pinkerton Live-Memory Continuity Protocol
objective: Preserve a James-derived autobiographical memory state before Project Purity and later instantiate that state in a compatible synthetic host using technology classes already demonstrated in shipped Fallout 3.
non_negotiable_boundaries: Do not use retrocausality: Pinkerton's 2276 stolen chip cannot already contain James's 2277 state.
Do not claim a post-exit James backup unless a new asset-level storage binding is found.
Do not overwrite A3-21/Harkness without his informed choice; prefer a separate compatible host.
Do not equate memory continuity with proven whole-person or soul continuity.
This is an experimental lore-consistent reconstruction, not a hidden vanilla quest solution.

protocol.name: IDENTIFY_LIVE_JAMES
protocol.when: During MQ04 while James is still connected to Vault 112 and represented as Doc.

protocol.name: SELECT_EVENT_ANCHOR
protocol.purpose: Capture the latest available James state before physical release without inventing historical backups.

protocol.name: USE_BRAUN_PER_USER_MEMORY_ACCESS

evidence_record.capability: override memory access for individual users

protocol.operation: Select James as source user and expose his accessible memory layer to an export path.

protocol.name: WRITE_TO_SEPARATE_MEMORY_CARRIER
protocol.rule: Use a separate/newly written carrier in 2277. Do not retroactively rewrite the history of Pinkerton's already-stolen 2276 chip.

protocol.name: PRESERVE_PROVENANCE
protocol.purpose: Avoid the source ambiguity demonstrated by Pinkerton's original stolen chip.

protocol.name: ALLOW_JAMES_A_TIMELINE_TO_CONTINUE
protocol.purpose: The continuity protocol does not need to rewrite the original MQ04 timeline.

protocol.name: OBTAIN_COMPATIBLE_SYNTH_HOST
protocol.constraint: Prefer a distinct compatible synthetic host rather than commandeering A3-21/Harkness.
protocol.governance_reason: Technical control over a host does not create identity authority over its current self.

protocol.name: PINKERTON_INTEGRATION
protocol.operation: Integrate the James-derived memory payload into the new compatible host as the dominant autobiographical layer.

protocol.name: IDENTITY_VALIDATION
tests: Recognition of the Lone Wanderer without prompting
Memory of Catherine consistent with pre-capture James knowledge
Memory of Vault 101 and Project Purity
Recognition that Doc was a simulation role rather than biological species
No Harkness/veteran or unknown-donor memory contamination
No memories of events occurring after the selected capture anchor

failure_modes.name: DOC_LOCKIN
failure_modes.symptom: Host identifies only as Doc or carries a dog-role self-model.
failure_modes.meaning: Capture selected too much Braun-imposed avatar-role state.

failure_modes.name: GENERIC_MEMORY_OVERLAY
failure_modes.symptom: Host has James memories but no stable James self-model.
failure_modes.meaning: Memory payload is not a complete identity/personality state.

failure_modes.name: SOURCE_CONTAMINATION
failure_modes.meaning: Carrier provenance was not cleanly rebound to James.

failure_modes.name: FALSE_POST_CAPTURE_MEMORY
failure_modes.symptom: Host recalls events after the capture anchor.
failure_modes.meaning: Provenance is inconsistent or unsupported biography was added.

ru: Спасение через Vault 112 следует строить не на недоказанном старом бэкапе, а на захвате живого состояния James до выхода из симуляции.
Vault 112 подтверждает индивидуальное управление доступом к памяти, а украденный mem chip подтверждает физический перенос memory-state за границу системы.
Pinkerton подтверждает второй конец цепочки: импорт внешнего memory payload в совместимого синтетического носителя.
Оригинальный чип 2276 года не может заранее содержать состояние James из 2277 года; нужен отдельный carrier или новая запись.
James_B является кандидатом на непрерывность памяти и автобиографии, но не доказанным переносом всего сознания или той же самой сущности.

next_gate.name: JAMES_SPECIFIC_MEMORY_WRITE_BINDING_AND_CARRIER_REUSE_AUDIT
targets: Find an ESM/GECK record binding a removable memory carrier to an individual Vault 112 resident.
Find a write/copy/export operation that moves selected per-user memory state onto a carrier.
Determine from shipped evidence whether a mem chip is reusable or rewritable.
Until then keep SAVE JAMES at conditional architectural status rather than canonical executable status.
